title: Invoice inbox app from PDF uploads
prompt: I get PDF invoices from suppliers and want an app to track them. I drop in one or more PDFs and each gets read automatically: supplier, invoice number, date, line items and total. I see them in a table and can open one to fix anything wrong. Flag any invoice whose line items don't add up to its total, to the cent, and clear the flag when my edits make them match. If the same supplier and invoice number come in twice, don't add it again, just tell me. A Suppliers page shows each supplier's spend by month, counting only invoices I've approved. Editing, approving or deleting an invoice updates those numbers right away. A file that can't be read shows as failed with the reason and doesn't stop the others. Save everything between visits. My Anthropic key is set up. Make it and get it working.
